questions.question: If the volume of a cube is 81sqrt 3 c{m³}, then its total surface area is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

volume of a cube = 81sqrt 3 c{m³}

**Formula used**

Total surface area of cube = 6 × (side)²

Volume of cube = (side)³

**Calculation**

81√3 = (side)³

⇒ 3 × 3 × 3 × 3 × √3 = (side)³

⇒ 3√3 = side (as 3 = √3 × √3)

Total surface area of cube = 6 × side²

⇒ 6 × 3√3 × 3√3

⇒ 54 × 3

⇒ 162 cm²

**∴ Total surface area of cube is 162 cm²**

questions.question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 24 days. B and C together can do it in 36 days. If A is thrice as good a workman as C, in how many days can B alone do the work?
questions.solution:
**Given**

A and B completes a work in 24 days

B and C completes a work in 36 days

Efficiency of A = 3 × efficiency of C

**Calculation**

Let C completes a work in x days.

so, A completes a work in (x/3) days

B completes a work in y days

One day work done by A and B 

(3/x) + (1/y) = 1/24

(1/y) + (1/x) = 1/36

let (1/x) = a and (1/y) = b

3a + b = 1/24

⇒ 72 a + 24b = 1 ---- (1)

b + a = 1/36

⇒ 36b + 36a = 1 ---- (2)

⇒ 36b = 1 - 36a

⇒ b = (1 - 36a)/36 ---- (3)

72a + 24(1 - 36a)/36 = 1 (from 1 and 3)

⇒ 72a + 2(1 - 36a)/3 = 1

⇒ 72a + (2 - 72a)/3 = 1

⇒ (216a + 2 - 72a )/3 = 1

⇒ 144a + 2 = 3

⇒ 144a = 3 -2

⇒ 144a = 1

a = 1/44

3 × (1/144) + b = 1/24 (from 1)

⇒ 1/48 + b = 1/24

⇒ b = (1/24 ) - (1/48)

⇒ b = (2 - 1)/48

⇒ b = 1/48

**∴ Number of days taken by B to complete a work is 48 days **

let the distance travelled in each speed is x km

⇒ (8x + 5x + 4x)/40 = 2 + (11/20)

⇒ 17x/40 = (40 + 11)/20

⇒ 17x/40 = 51/20

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 3 ∶ 5 ∶ 7 and their LCM is 840. Their HCF is:
questions.solution:

Ratio of three numbers = 3 ∶ 5 ∶ 7

⇒ r³ = (0.4 × 0.4 × 14400 × 3)/4

questions.question: The mean of 50 items was 24. Later on, it was discovered that two items were misread as 83 and 17 instead of 38 and 77. The correct mean is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Number of items = 50

Mean = 50

**Formula used**

Mean = sum of observation/Number of observation

**Calculation**

Sum of observation = 50 × 24

⇒ 1200

correct mean = (Sum of observation - wrong item included + right item)/Number of items

correct mean = (1200 - 83 - 17 + 38 + 77)/50

⇒ 1215/50

⇒ 24.3

**∴ The correct mean is 24.3**

questions.question: If the area of the base of a cone is 154 cm² and the area of the curved surface is 550 cm², then its volume is: ( {Take pi = frac{{22}}{7} } )
questions.solution:
**Given**

Area of base of cone = 154 cm²

Area of curved surface = 550 cm²

**Formula used**

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr2h

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

where l is slant height

l = √h² + r²

**Calculation**

Area of base of cone = πr²

(22/7) × r² = 154

⇒ r² = (154 × 7)/22

⇒ r² = 1078/22

⇒ r² = 49

⇒ r = 7 cm

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

550 = (22/7) × 7 × l

⇒ 550/22 = l

⇒ 25 = l

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

h = √l² - r²

⇒ h = √(25)² - (7)²

⇒ h = √625 - 49

⇒ h = √576

⇒ h = 24

Volume of cone = (1/3) × (22/7) × 7 × 7 × 24

⇒ 22 × 7 × 8

⇒ 22 × 56

⇒ 1232 cm³

**∴ Volume of cone is 1232 cm³**

questions.question: Varun gave 60% of the money he had to his wife. He also gave 20% of the remaining amount to each of his three children. Three-fifth of the amount now left was spent on miscellaneous items, and the remaining amount of Rs. 9,600 was deposited in the bank. How much money did Varun have initially?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Amount given to wife = 60% of total money

Amount given to three children each = 20% of money left after giving to wife

Amount spent on miscellaneous items = (3/5)th of the money left after giving to wife and children

Amount deposited = 9600

**Concept**

Total money = sum of the money given to wife , children, spent on miscellaneous items and deposited in bank

**Calculation**

let the total money is Rs.x

amount given to wife = 60% of x

⇒60x/100

Money left after given to wife = x - 60% of x

⇒40x/100

Amount given to three children = 3 × (40x/100) × 20%

⇒(120x/100) × (20/100)

⇒24x/100

Amount left for miscellaneous items = x - [(60x/100) + (24x/100)]

⇒x - (84x/100)

⇒(100x - 84x)/100

⇒16x/100

Amount spent on miscellaneous items = (3/5) × (16x/100)

⇒48x/500

According to question

(60x/100) + (24x/100) + (48x/500) + 9600 = x

⇒(84x/100) + (48x/500) + 9600 = x

⇒[(420x + 48x)/500 ] + 9600 = x

⇒[468x/500] + 9600 = x

⇒9600 = x - (468x/500)

⇒9600 = (500x - 468x)/500

⇒9600 = 32x/500

⇒(9600 × 500)/32 = x

⇒300 × 500 = x

⇒150000 = x

**∴ Initial amount Varun has is RS.1,50,000**.

questions.question: The average age of a group of students in a class is 15.5 years. 15 new students with an average age of 14.5 years join the group, due to which the average age of students in the class becomes 15 years. The number of students initially present in the class is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Average age of old number of students = 15.5 years

Average age of new 15 students = 14.5

Average age of old number of students and 15 new students = 15

**Formula used**

Average = Sum of observation/Number of observation

**Calculation**

Let the number of students = x

Sum of the ages of x students = 15.5 × x

⇒ 15.5x

New sum of the ages of 15 students = 15 × 14.5

⇒ 217.5

Total sum of the ages of (x + 15) students = 15.5x + 217.5 ---- (1)

and total sum of the ages of (x + 15) students = (x + 15) × 15

15x + 225 ----(2)

from 1 and 2

15.5x + 217.5 = 15x + 225

⇒15.5x - 15x = 225 - 217.5

⇒0.5x = 7.5

⇒x = 15

**∴ The number of students initially present in the class is 15**

questions.question:
Each of the measure of the radius of a cylinder and that of a sphere is 10.5 cm. Also, the volumes of these two solids are equal. The curved surface area of the cylinder is:

( {Take pi = frac{{22}}{7} } )
questions.solution:

Radius of cylinder = Radius of sphere = 10.5 cm

Volume of cylinder = Volume of sphere

**Formula used**

Volume of cylinder = πr2h

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr3

**Calculation**

Volume of cylinder = Volume of sphere

πr²h = (4/3)πr³

⇒ h = (4/3)r

⇒ h = (4/3) × 10.5

⇒ h = 14

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 10.5 × 14

⇒ 2 × 22 × 10.5 × 2

⇒ 88 × 10.5

⇒ 924 cm²

**∴ The curved surface area of cylinder is 924 cm²**

questions.question: Naveen took two loans, altogether for Rs. 9,400, from Suman and Arya. Suman claimed 12(1)/(2)% simple interest per annum, while Arya claimed 10(1)/(2)% per annum. The total interest paid by Naveen in one year was Rs. 1,063. The sum borrowed from Arya is:

Loan amount = Rs 9400

Simple interest rate on amount of loan taken from Suman = 12(1)/(2)%

Simple interest rate on amount of loan taken from Arya = 101over2% per annum

**Formula used**

Simple interest = (Principal × rate × time)/100

**Calculation**

Let the loan taken from suman is Rs x

and loan taken from Arya is (9400 -x)

interest paid to Suman = (x × 25 × 1)/(100 × 2)

⇒ 25x/200

⇒ x/8

Interest paid to Arya = [(9400 -x) × (21) × 1]/(100 × 2)

⇒ (197400 - 21x)/200

According to question

1063 = (x/8) + (197400 - 21x)/200

⇒ 1063 = (25x + 197400 - 21x)/200

⇒ 1063 = (4x + 197400)/200

⇒ 212600 = 4x + 197400

⇒ 212600 - 197400 = 4x

⇒ 15200 = 4x

⇒ 3800 = x

Sum borrowed from Arya = 9400 - 3800

questions.question: The compound interest obtained on Rs. 6,250 for two years at the rate of interest 8% per annum, compounded annually, will be:

Rate = 8% per annu**m**

**Formula used**

A = P(1 + r%)t

where p and r are principal and rate respectively

Compound interest = Amount - Principal

**Calculation**

A = 6250 (1 + 8%)²

⇒A = 6250 × (108/100) × (108/100)

⇒A = 6250 × (27/25)&
nbsp;× (27/25)

⇒A = 10 × 27 × 27

⇒A = 7290

Compound interest = 7290 - 6250

⇒1040
